scheduler.retained_for_later_but_not_sca.translation: Disimpan untuk nanti, namun tidak dipindai secara terpisah saat Pemindaian disk penuh dipilih.

scheduler.run_saved_scans_automatically_.StringInEng: Run saved scans automatically while ClamShield is running in the tray.
scheduler.run_saved_scans_automatically_.translation: Jalankan pemindaian tersimpan secara otomatis saat ClamShield berjalan di baki.

scheduler.scan_all_local_files_saved_dir.StringInEng: Scan all local files. Saved directories are skipped to avoid scanning them twice.
scheduler.scan_all_local_files_saved_dir.translation: Pindai semua file lokal. Direktori yang disimpan dilewati untuk menghindari pemindaian dua kali.

scheduler.scan_executable_images_loaded_.StringInEng: Scan executable images loaded by running processes, without a separate file target.
scheduler.scan_executable_images_loaded_.translation: Pindai gambar yang dapat dieksekusi yang dimuat dengan proses yang berjalan, tanpa target file terpisah.

scheduler.scan_only_if_the_computer_is_n.StringInEng: Scan only if the computer is not being used
scheduler.scan_only_if_the_computer_is_n.translation: Pindai hanya jika komputer tidak digunakan

scheduler.these_choices_are_saved_so_fol.StringInEng: These choices are saved, so folders only need to be selected once.
scheduler.these_choices_are_saved_so_fol.translation: Pilihan ini disimpan, jadi folder hanya perlu dipilih satu kali.

scheduler.wait_for_15_minutes_of_windows.StringInEng: Wait for 15 minutes of Windows keyboard and mouse inactivity. If activity resumes during the scan, ClamShield stops it.
scheduler.wait_for_15_minutes_of_windows.translation: Tunggu 15 menit jika keyboard dan mouse Windows tidak aktif. Jika aktivitas dilanjutkan selama pemindaian, ClamShield menghentikannya.

settings.1_10_extremely_gentle_idle_prio.StringInEng: 1-10: Extremely gentle. Idle priority, 1 worker, 100-file total batch window, 500 ms pause.
settings.1_10_extremely_gentle_idle_prio.translation: 1-10: Sangat lembut. Prioritas tidak aktif, 1 pekerja, total jendela batch 100 file, jeda 500 ms.

settings.11_20_very_gentle_idle_priority.StringInEng: 11-20: Very gentle. Idle priority, 1 worker, 250-file total batch window, 250 ms pause.
settings.11_20_very_gentle_idle_priority.translation: 11-20: Sangat lembut. Prioritas tidak aktif, 1 pekerja, total jendela batch 250 file, jeda 250 ms.

settings.21_30_gentle_below_normal_prior.StringInEng: 21-30: Gentle. Below-normal priority, 1 worker, 500-file total batch window, 150 ms pause.
settings.21_30_gentle_below_normal_prior.translation: 21-30: Lembut. Prioritas di bawah normal, 1 pekerja, total jendela batch 500 file, jeda 150 ms.

settings.31_40_light_below_normal_priori.StringInEng: 31-40: Light. Below-normal priority, 1 worker, 1,000-file total batch window, 75 ms pause.
settings.31_40_light_below_normal_priori.translation: 31-40: Ringan. Prioritas di bawah normal, 1 pekerja, total jendela batch 1.000 file, jeda 75 ms.

settings.41_50_balanced_below_normal_pri.StringInEng: 41-50: Balanced. Below-normal priority, 2 workers, 2,000-file total batch window split between workers, 25 ms pause.
settings.41_50_balanced_below_normal_pri.translation: 41-50: Seimbang. Prioritas di bawah normal, 2 pekerja, total jendela batch 2.000 file terbagi antar pekerja, jeda 25 mdtk.

settings.51_60_active_normal_priority_2_.StringInEng: 51-60: Active. Normal priority, 2 workers, 3,000-file total batch window split between workers, no pause.
settings.51_60_active_normal_priority_2_.translation: 51-60: Aktif. Prioritas normal, 2 pekerja, total jendela batch 3.000 file dibagi antar pekerja, tanpa jeda.

settings.61_70_fast_normal_priority_work.StringInEng: 61-70: Fast. Normal priority, {{halfCores}} workers, 5,000-file total batch window split between workers, no pause.
settings.61_70_fast_normal_priority_work.translation: 61-70: Cepat. Prioritas normal, pekerja {{halfCores}}, jendela batch total 5.000 file dibagi antar pekerja, tanpa jeda.

settings.71_80_very_fast_normal_priority.StringInEng: 71-80: Very fast. Normal priority, {{threeQuarterCores}} workers, 10,000-file total batch window split between workers, no pause.
settings.71_80_very_fast_normal_priority.translation: 71-80: Sangat cepat. Prioritas normal, pekerja {{threeQuarterCores}}, jendela batch total 10.000 file dibagi antar pekerja, tanpa jeda.

settings.81_90_maximum_minus_one_core_hi.StringInEng: 81-90: Maximum minus one core. High priority, {{value1}} workers, 15,000-file total batch window split between workers, no pause.
settings.81_90_maximum_minus_one_core_hi.translation: 81-90: Maksimum dikurangi satu inti. Prioritas tinggi, pekerja {{value1}}, jendela batch total 15.000 file dibagi antar pekerja, tanpa jeda.

settings.91_100_maximum_high_priority_al.StringInEng: 91-100: Maximum. High priority, all {{allCores}} logical cores, 25,000-file total batch window split between workers, no pause. The PC may be hard to use until the scan finishes.
settings.91_100_maximum_high_priority_al.translation: 91-100: Maksimum. Prioritas tinggi, semua inti logis {{allCores}}, jendela batch total 25.000 file dibagi antar pekerja, tanpa jeda. PC mungkin sulit digunakan hingga pemindaian selesai.

settings.action_required_before_defender.StringInEng: Action required before Defender can be paused
settings.action_required_before_defender.translation: Diperlukan tindakan sebelum Defender dapat dijeda

settings.actions_and_final_warning_popup.StringInEng: Actions and final warning popup for on-demand and scheduled scans.
settings.actions_and_final_warning_popup.translation: Tindakan dan popup peringatan terakhir untuk pemindaian sesuai permintaan dan terjadwal.

settings.adds_clamshield_scan_and_except.StringInEng: Adds ClamShield scan and exception actions to File Explorer right-click menus.
settings.adds_clamshield_scan_and_except.translation: Menambahkan tindakan pemindaian dan pengecualian ClamShield ke menu klik kanan File Explorer.

settings.api_key_saved_locally_in_window.StringInEng: API key saved locally in Windows secure storage.
settings.api_key_saved_locally_in_window.translation: Kunci API disimpan secara lokal di penyimpanan aman Windows.

settings.ask_before_checking_more_than_4.StringInEng: Ask before checking more than 4 files and show the estimated time.
settings.ask_before_checking_more_than_4.translation: Tanyakan sebelum memeriksa lebih dari 4 file dan tunjukkan perkiraan waktunya.

settings.automatically_labels_new_result.StringInEng: Automatically labels new Results findings with a VirusTotal verdict.
settings.automatically_labels_new_result.translation: Secara otomatis memberi label pada temuan Hasil baru dengan keputusan VirusTotal.

settings.automatically_launch_clamshield.StringInEng: Automatically launch ClamShield background service when you sign into Windows.
settings.automatically_launch_clamshield.translation: Secara otomatis meluncurkan layanan latar belakang ClamShield saat Anda masuk ke Windows.

settings.clamshield_runs_alongside_micro.StringInEng: ClamShield runs alongside Microsoft Defender by default. ClamShield is a user interface for ClamAV and YARA, so it does not claim to be an independent antivirus provider or register itself as one in Windows Security. You may optionally request that Defender real-time protection be paused to reduce duplicate scanning.
settings.clamshield_runs_alongside_micro.translation: ClamShield berjalan bersama Microsoft Defender secara default. ClamShield adalah antarmuka pengguna untuk ClamAV dan YARA, sehingga tidak mengklaim sebagai penyedia antivirus independen atau mendaftarkan dirinya sebagai salah satu di Windows Security. Anda juga dapat meminta agar perlindungan real-time Defender dijeda untuk mengurangi pemindaian duplikat.

settings.configure_clamav_paths_and_scan.StringInEng: Configure ClamAV paths and scanner options
settings.configure_clamav_paths_and_scan.translation: Konfigurasikan jalur ClamAV dan opsi pemindai

settings.could_not_configure_the_windows.StringInEng: Could not configure the Windows Context Menu.
settings.could_not_configure_the_windows.translation: Tidak dapat mengonfigurasi Menu Konteks Windows.

settings.could_not_configure_virustotal_.StringInEng: Could not configure VirusTotal Cloud Check.
settings.could_not_configure_virustotal_.translation: Tidak dapat mengonfigurasi VirusTotal Cloud Check.

settings.could_not_read_microsoft_defend.StringInEng: Could not read Microsoft Defender status.
settings.could_not_read_microsoft_defend.translation: Tidak dapat membaca status Microsoft Defender.

settings.could_not_remove_the_virustotal.StringInEng: Could not remove the VirusTotal API key.
settings.could_not_remove_the_virustotal.translation: Tidak dapat menghapus kunci VirusTotal API.

settings.default_is_7_days_logs_are_stor.StringInEng: Default is 7 days. Logs are stored under C:\ProgramData\ClamShield\logs.
settings.default_is_7_days_logs_are_stor.translation: Defaultnya adalah 7 hari. Log disimpan di C:\ProgramData\ClamShield\logs.

settings.enjoying_clamshield_consider_su.StringInEng: Enjoying ClamShield? Consider supporting the development of this application. Your donations help keep it maintained and free!
settings.enjoying_clamshield_consider_su.translation: Menikmati ClamShield? Pertimbangkan untuk mendukung pengembangan aplikasi ini. Donasi Anda membantu menjaganya tetap terpelihara dan gratis!

settings.exclude_clamshield_yara_and_qua.StringInEng: Exclude ClamShield YARA and quarantine from Defender
settings.exclude_clamshield_yara_and_qua.translation: Kecualikan ClamShield YARA dan karantina dari Defender

settings.helps_prevent_duplicate_handlin.StringInEng: Helps prevent duplicate handling of rule files and quarantined items.
settings.helps_prevent_duplicate_handlin.translation: Membantu mencegah duplikat penanganan file aturan dan item yang dikarantina.

settings.language_help.StringInEng: Add a UTF-8 JSON translation file to the languages folder, then refresh the list.
settings.language_help.translation: Tambahkan file terjemahan UTF-8 JSON ke folder bahasa, lalu segarkan daftarnya.

settings.language_invalid.StringInEng: Some language files were rejected. Fix the reported errors and refresh the list.
settings.language_invalid.translation: Beberapa file bahasa ditolak. Perbaiki kesalahan yang dilaporkan dan segarkan daftar.

settings.larger_memory_footprint_1gb_ram.StringInEng: Larger memory footprint (~1GB RAM), less CPU overhead.
settings.larger_memory_footprint_1gb_ram.translation: Jejak memori lebih besar (~1 GB RAM), overhead CPU lebih sedikit.

settings.leave_blank_to_keep_the_saved_k.StringInEng: Leave blank to keep the saved key
settings.leave_blank_to_keep_the_saved_k.translation: Biarkan kosong untuk menyimpan kunci yang disimpan

settings.main_app_popup_renderer_and_ser.StringInEng: Main app, popup, renderer, and service errors are written to the logs folder. Turn on debug log only while investigating a problem.
settings.main_app_popup_renderer_and_ser.translation: Kesalahan aplikasi utama, popup, penyaji, dan layanan ditulis ke folder log. Aktifkan log debug hanya saat menyelidiki masalah.

settings.microsoft_defender_real_time_pr.StringInEng: Microsoft Defender real-time protection is paused.

settings.only_after_virustotal_has_no_re.StringInEng: Only after VirusTotal has no report for the hash.
settings.only_after_virustotal_has_no_re.translation: Hanya setelah VirusTotal tidak memiliki laporan untuk hash.

settings.open_clamshield_as_a_tray_icon_.StringInEng: Open ClamShield as a tray icon without showing the main window.
settings.open_clamshield_as_a_tray_icon_.translation: Buka ClamShield sebagai ikon baki tanpa menampilkan jendela utama.

settings.open_windows_security_and_disab.StringInEng: Open Windows Security and disable Tamper Protection first.
settings.open_windows_security_and_disab.translation: Buka Keamanan Windows dan nonaktifkan Perlindungan Tamper terlebih dahulu.

settings.optional_only_works_when_window.StringInEng: Optional. Only works when Windows permits the change and Tamper Protection is off.
settings.optional_only_works_when_window.translation: Opsional. Hanya berfungsi jika Windows mengizinkan perubahan dan Perlindungan Tamper tidak aktif.

settings.ram_warning_this_pc_reports_abo.StringInEng: RAM warning: this PC reports about {{deviceMemory}} GB RAM. High parallel clamscan intensity can load signatures in multiple workers. Offload to memory uses clamdscan and is safer for RAM.
settings.ram_warning_this_pc_reports_abo.translation: Peringatan RAM: PC ini melaporkan tentang RAM {{deviceMemory}} GB. Intensitas clamscan paralel yang tinggi dapat memuat tanda tangan di banyak pekerja. Offload ke memori menggunakan clamdscan dan lebih aman untuk RAM.

settings.return_here_and_click_check_aga.StringInEng: Return here and click Check again.
settings.return_here_and_click_check_aga.translation: Kembali ke sini dan klik Periksa lagi.

settings.runtime_limits_used_when_the_sc.StringInEng: Runtime limits used when the scanner evaluates files with local YARA rules.
settings.runtime_limits_used_when_the_sc.translation: Batas waktu proses yang digunakan saat pemindai mengevaluasi file dengan aturan YARA lokal.

settings.securiteinfo_offers_hourly_clam.StringInEng: SecuriteInfo offers hourly ClamAV signature updates through a subscription service for improved zero-day detection coverage.
settings.securiteinfo_offers_hourly_clam.translation: SecuriteInfo menawarkan pembaruan tanda tangan ClamAV setiap jam melalui layanan berlangganan untuk meningkatkan cakupan deteksi zero-day.

settings.shows_a_summary_popup_after_a_s.StringInEng: Shows a summary popup after a scan finishes with detections, and when a scheduled scan stops.
settings.shows_a_summary_popup_after_a_s.translation: Menampilkan popup ringkasan setelah pemindaian selesai dengan deteksi, dan ketika pemindaian terjadwal berhenti.

settings.tamper_protection_blocks_apps_f.StringInEng: Tamper Protection blocks apps from changing protected Microsoft Defender settings. Keeping Defender and ClamShield in side-by-side mode is supported and avoids leaving the computer without Defender protection.
settings.tamper_protection_blocks_apps_f.translation: Tamper Protection memblokir aplikasi agar tidak mengubah pengaturan Microsoft Defender yang dilindungi. Menjaga Defender dan ClamShield dalam mode berdampingan didukung dan menghindari meninggalkan komputer tanpa perlindungan Defender.

settings.tamper_protection_is_off_you_ca.StringInEng: Tamper Protection is off. You can now try Pause Defender.
settings.tamper_protection_is_off_you_ca.translation: Perlindungan Tamper tidak aktif. Anda sekarang dapat mencoba Pause Defender.

settings.tamper_protection_is_still_on_w.StringInEng: Tamper Protection is still on. Windows will block Defender pause requests.
settings.tamper_protection_is_still_on_w.translation: Perlindungan Tamper masih aktif. Windows akan memblokir permintaan jeda Defender.

settings.upload_results_files_without_a_.StringInEng: Upload Results files without a VT report
settings.upload_results_files_without_a_.translation: Unggah file Hasil tanpa laporan VT

settings.use_local_yara_rules_during_man.StringInEng: Use local YARA rules during manual, scheduled, and Shield scans.
settings.use_local_yara_rules_during_man.translation: Gunakan aturan YARA lokal selama pemindaian manual, terjadwal, dan Shield.

settings.warn_me_with_a_popup_at_the_end.StringInEng: Warn me with a popup at the end of the scan
settings.warn_me_with_a_popup_at_the_end.translation: Peringatkan saya dengan popup di akhir pemindaian

settings.who_provides_excellent_third_pa.StringInEng: , who provides excellent third-party signatures for ClamAV to detect the newest threats.
settings.who_provides_excellent_third_pa.translation: , yang memberikan tanda tangan pihak ketiga yang sangat baik untuk ClamAV guna mendeteksi ancaman terbaru.

settings.windows_blocked_the_defender_ch.StringInEng: Windows blocked the Defender change. Check Tamper Protection, administrator access, or device policy.
settings.windows_blocked_the_defender_ch.translation: Windows memblokir perubahan Defender. Periksa Perlindungan Tamper, akses administrator, atau kebijakan perangkat.

settings.windows_did_not_report_the_tamp.StringInEng: Windows did not report the Tamper Protection state. You may still try the action below.
settings.windows_did_not_report_the_tamp.translation: Windows tidak melaporkan status Perlindungan Tamper. Anda masih dapat mencoba tindakan di bawah ini.

settings.windows_security_could_not_be_o.StringInEng: Windows Security could not be opened.

settings.windows_security_opened_go_to_v.StringInEng: Windows Security opened. Go to Virus & threat protection → Manage settings → Tamper Protection.
settings.windows_security_opened_go_to_v.translation: Windows Keamanan dibuka. Buka Perlindungan virus & ancaman → Kelola pengaturan → Perlindungan Tamper.

settings.windows_tamper_protection_is_on.StringInEng: Windows Tamper Protection is on. Open Windows Security, turn it off, then check again.
settings.windows_tamper_protection_is_on.translation: Perlindungan Tamper Windows aktif. Buka Windows Security, matikan, lalu periksa kembali.

settings.writes_extra_startup_popup_and_.StringInEng: Writes extra startup, popup, and service details. Error and crash logs are always kept so white screens can be diagnosed.
settings.writes_extra_startup_popup_and_.translation: Menulis detail startup, popup, dan layanan tambahan. Log kesalahan dan kerusakan selalu disimpan sehingga layar putih dapat didiagnosis.

shield.1_10_extremely_gentle_idle_priori.StringInEng: 1-10: Extremely gentle. Idle priority, 1 Shield worker, 100-file total event window, 500 ms pause.
shield.1_10_extremely_gentle_idle_priori.translation: 1-10: Sangat lembut. Prioritas tidak aktif, 1 pekerja Perisai, total jendela peristiwa 100 file, jeda 500 ms.

shield.11_20_very_gentle_idle_priority_1.StringInEng: 11-20: Very gentle. Idle priority, 1 Shield worker, 250-file total event window, 250 ms pause.
shield.11_20_very_gentle_idle_priority_1.translation: 11-20: Sangat lembut. Prioritas tidak aktif, 1 pekerja Perisai, total jendela peristiwa 250 file, jeda 250 ms.

shield.21_30_gentle_below_normal_priorit.StringInEng: 21-30: Gentle. Below-normal priority, 1 Shield worker, 500-file total event window, 150 ms pause.
shield.21_30_gentle_below_normal_priorit.translation: 21-30: Lembut. Prioritas di bawah normal, 1 pekerja Perisai, total jendela peristiwa 500 file, jeda 150 ms.

shield.31_40_light_below_normal_priority.StringInEng: 31-40: Light. Below-normal priority, 1 Shield worker, 1,000-file total event window, 75 ms pause.
shield.31_40_light_below_normal_priority.translation: 31-40: Ringan. Prioritas di bawah normal, 1 pekerja Perisai, total jendela peristiwa 1.000 file, jeda 75 ms.

shield.41_50_balanced_below_normal_prior.StringInEng: 41-50: Balanced. Below-normal priority, 2 Shield workers, 2,000-file total event window split between workers, 25 ms pause.
shield.41_50_balanced_below_normal_prior.translation: 41-50: Seimbang. Prioritas di bawah normal, 2 pekerja Perisai, total jendela peristiwa 2.000 file terbagi antar pekerja, jeda 25 mdtk.

shield.51_60_active_normal_priority_2_sh.StringInEng: 51-60: Active. Normal priority, 2 Shield workers, 3,000-file total event window split between workers, no pause.
shield.51_60_active_normal_priority_2_sh.translation: 51-60: Aktif. Prioritas normal, 2 pekerja Perisai, total jendela peristiwa 3.000 file dibagi antar pekerja, tanpa jeda.

shield.61_70_fast_normal_priority_shield.StringInEng: 61-70: Fast. Normal priority, {{halfCores}} Shield workers, 5,000-file total event window split between workers, no pause.
shield.61_70_fast_normal_priority_shield.translation: 61-70: Cepat. Prioritas normal, pekerja {{halfCores}} Shield, jendela peristiwa total 5.000 file dibagi antar pekerja, tanpa jeda.

shield.71_80_very_fast_normal_priority_s.StringInEng: 71-80: Very fast. Normal priority, {{threeQuarterCores}} Shield workers, 10,000-file total event window split between workers, no pause.
shield.71_80_very_fast_normal_priority_s.translation: 71-80: Sangat cepat. Prioritas normal, pekerja {{threeQuarterCores}} Shield, jendela peristiwa total 10.000 file dibagi antar pekerja, tanpa jeda.

shield.81_90_maximum_minus_one_core_high.StringInEng: 81-90: Maximum minus one core. High priority, {{value1}} Shield workers, 15,000-file total event window split between workers, no pause.
shield.81_90_maximum_minus_one_core_high.translation: 81-90: Maksimum dikurangi satu inti. Prioritas tinggi, pekerja {{value1}} Shield, jendela peristiwa total 15.000 file dibagi antar pekerja, tanpa jeda.

shield.91_100_maximum_high_priority_all_.StringInEng: 91-100: Maximum. High priority, all {{allCores}} logical cores, 25,000-file total event window split between workers, no pause. The PC may be hard to use when many files change.
shield.91_100_maximum_high_priority_all_.translation: 91-100: Maksimal. Prioritas tinggi, semua inti logis {{allCores}}, total jendela peristiwa 25.000 file dibagi antar pekerja, tanpa jeda. PC mungkin sulit digunakan ketika banyak file berubah.

shield.adds_virustotal_as_a_background_s.StringInEng: Adds VirusTotal as a background Shield engine.
shield.adds_virustotal_as_a_background_s.translation: Menambahkan VirusTotal sebagai mesin Pelindung latar belakang.

shield.auto_quarantine_and_notify_me.translation: Karantina otomatis dan beri tahu saya

shield.background_protection_against_new.StringInEng: Background protection against new and modified files
shield.background_protection_against_new.translation: Perlindungan latar belakang terhadap file baru dan yang dimodifikasi

shield.choose_the_real_time_shield_actio.StringInEng: Choose the real-time Shield action and whether it notifies you.
shield.choose_the_real_time_shield_actio.translation: Pilih tindakan Perisai real-time dan apakah tindakan tersebut akan memberi tahu Anda.

shield.forget_the_real_time_shield_scann.StringInEng: Forget the real-time shield scanned-file cache? Existing files will be treated as unknown again when they change or are scanned.
shield.forget_the_real_time_shield_scann.translation: Lupakan cache file pindaian perisai real-time? File yang ada akan diperlakukan sebagai tidak diketahui lagi ketika diubah atau dipindai.

shield.how_long_a_file_must_stop_changin.StringInEng: How long a file must stop changing before Shield scans it. Higher values are better for many simultaneous downloads and large files.
shield.how_long_a_file_must_stop_changin.translation: Berapa lama file harus berhenti berubah sebelum Shield memindainya. Nilai yang lebih tinggi lebih baik untuk banyak unduhan simultan dan file besar.

shield.how_many_levels_below_watched_fol.StringInEng: How many levels below watched folders the shield monitors
shield.how_many_levels_below_watched_fol.translation: Berapa level di bawah folder yang dipantau oleh perisai

shield.how_often_clamshield_checks_wheth.StringInEng: How often ClamShield checks whether a changing file has become stable. Lower values react sooner but wake the disk/CPU more often.
shield.how_often_clamshield_checks_wheth.translation: Seberapa sering ClamShield memeriksa apakah file yang diubah sudah stabil. Nilai yang lebih rendah bereaksi lebih cepat tetapi membangunkan disk/CPU lebih sering.

shield.no_custom_browser_download_folder.StringInEng: No custom browser download folders detected
shield.no_custom_browser_download_folder.translation: Tidak ada folder unduhan browser khusus yang terdeteksi

shield.only_after_the_hash_is_unknown.StringInEng: Only after the hash is unknown.

shield.opens_the_threat_popup_so_you_can.StringInEng: Opens the threat popup so you can quarantine, add an exception, or decide later.
shield.opens_the_threat_popup_so_you_can.translation: Membuka popup ancaman sehingga Anda dapat melakukan karantina, menambahkan pengecualian, atau memutuskan nanti.

shield.play_a_short_bundled_alert_sound_.StringInEng: Play a short bundled alert sound when Shield opens a decision or notification popup.
shield.play_a_short_bundled_alert_sound_.translation: Memutar suara peringatan singkat saat Shield membuka popup keputusan atau notifikasi.

shield.quarantines_the_file_immediately_.StringInEng: Quarantines the file immediately, then shows a Shield notification popup.
shield.quarantines_the_file_immediately_.translation: Segera karantina file, lalu tampilkan popup notifikasi Perisai.

shield.quarantines_the_file_immediately_.StringInEng: Quarantines the file immediately without showing a popup.
shield.quarantines_the_file_immediately_.translation: Segera karantina file tanpa menampilkan popup.

shield.saves_the_detection_to_results_th.StringInEng: Saves the detection to Results, then shows a Shield notification popup.
shield.saves_the_detection_to_results_th.translation: Menyimpan deteksi ke Hasil, lalu menampilkan popup notifikasi Perisai.

shield.saves_the_detection_to_results_wi.StringInEng: Saves the detection to Results without showing a popup.
shield.saves_the_detection_to_results_wi.translation: Menyimpan deteksi ke Hasil tanpa menampilkan popup.

shield.send_to_results_and_notify_me.StringInEng: Send to Results and notify me
shield.send_to_results_and_notify_me.translation: Kirim ke Hasil dan beri tahu saya

shield.set_up_virustotal_cloud_check_fir.StringInEng: Set up VirusTotal Cloud Check first.
shield.set_up_virustotal_cloud_check_fir.translation: Siapkan VirusTotal Cloud Check terlebih dahulu.

shield.upload_files_without_a_virustotal.StringInEng: Upload files without a VirusTotal report
